test_case.purpose: Sustain approved load on both sockets for 12 hours at measured 40C and +5% 5V/3.3V rails and prove each reaches the project-defined power envelope without hang, throttling violation, RAS or BMC error.
required_package: Pinned stress-ng or vendor tool/profile and per-socket load floor
Calibrated chamber/rails and thermal/power/RAS abort limits
test_case.test_command: Operator preserves baseline, verifies socket affinity and calibrated environment, ramps to approved 40C/+5% rails, then runs the pinned dual-socket workload for 12 hours while recording per-socket utilization/frequency/package power/temperature/throttling/RAS, system heartbeat and BMC events. Compare the named power statistic only to the signed target; restore nominal environment and verify health.
test_case.expected_result: Both sockets maintain the approved load and power envelope for the complete exposure with no disallowed throttle, RAS, tool/BMC error, hang or BSOD, and nominal restoration succeeds.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires complete dual-socket coverage, continuous environment, signed power oracle and calculation, health evidence and restoration. Overall utilization, one loaded socket, undefined 'max', a short run or exit zero alone cannot pass.
safety_gate: Qualified operator with cooling/feed headroom and OOB
Independent environment and per-socket power/thermal measurement
Abort on thermal/power/RAS/heartbeat limit or control loss
Preserve logs, restore nominal, no auto-retry
test_case.recovery: On any environmental, CPU, RAS or heartbeat fault, stop load, preserve synchronized evidence, use OOB if needed, return rails/ambient to nominal, verify both sockets/system and require separate approval for a rerun.
